outlier_detection.method: Univariate Tukey IQR rule: values below Q1 - 1.5*IQR or above Q3 + 1.5*IQR.
outlier_detection.warning: IQR outliers are statistical flags, not automatic errors. They may reflect valid regional, crop, or measurement variation.

data_quality_flags: No exact duplicate records were found.
All rows have the expected 20 fields.
Temperature contains 382 negative values; review units, geography, and whether these are valid minimum/average temperatures.
Rainfall, nutrient, fertilizer, and yield fields are strongly right-skewed and contain many IQR outlier flags.
Source labels show normal-based or backfilled provenance for some observations.
Yield unit is not specified, so metric interpretation and cross-source comparability remain unresolved.
Region is structurally derived from District and State in every row, creating duplicated geographic information.
recommendations_before_training: Confirm the target unit and yield definition from the dataset creator or source documentation.
Validate negative temperatures and the meaning/units of all numeric agronomic fields.
Keep source labels as provenance metadata; test whether including them as model inputs causes source leakage.
Use a grouped or time-aware split by geography, crop, and/or year to avoid leakage from repeated contexts.
Treat outliers using domain review rather than blanket deletion; the original CSV must remain unchanged.
Encode categorical fields and scale/transform skewed numeric fields only in derived training data.
